faq.title: Clear answers before we start
faq.subtitle: Scope, geographic coverage, process digitization, custom software delivery, and QA collaboration details.

items.q: Do you only work in León, Guanajuato, or also across Mexico and internationally?
items.a: I am based in León, Guanajuato (available onsite/hybrid across the Bajío corridor) and work remotely with companies nationwide in Mexico as well as international teams in the US and abroad in English or Spanish.

items.q: How do you help digitize or optimize workflows currently run in spreadsheets or chat?
items.a: I audit your current workflow to pinpoint bottlenecks, manual rework, and error-prone handoffs, then engineer a custom web system or AI-assisted automation tailored to your operation with permissions and real-time visibility.

items.q: Can we hire you specifically for software testing and QA leadership?
items.a: Yes. I can plug directly into your engineering team to establish QA strategy, author functional and regression test plans, validate APIs, automate critical paths, and set release gates before production deploys.

items.q: Can you build a product from scratch even if we do not have technical specs yet?
items.a: Yes. I guide you from business scoping and process mapping to system architecture, full-stack development, AI integration, QA validation, and production deployment.

items.q: Can you collaborate and lead technical work fluently in English?
items.a: Yes. I work fluently in both English and Spanish across stakeholder calls, technical specifications, agile project leadership, and distributed engineering coordination.

items.q: How do we start a project or technical audit?
items.a: Reach out via direct WhatsApp or the contact form with your goal, operational challenge, or engineering need; we align on scope in a brief discovery call and map out an actionable delivery plan.
